description_en: Grants a virtual private cloud (VPC) or a virtual border router (VBR) from another account to an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 将的专有网络（VPC）或者边界路由器（VBR）授权给跨账号的专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）
kebab_example: aliyun expressconnectrouter grant-instance-to-express-connect-router --ecr-id ecr-mezk2idmsd0vx20000 --ecr-owner-ali-uid 1210123456120000 --instance-id vbr-j6cwxhgg0s5nuephp0000 --instance-type VBR --instance-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GrantInstanceToExpressConnectRouter

parameters.help_en: The ID of the associated ECR
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the ECR instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 接受授权的专线网关实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: ecr_owner_ali_uid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

VBR
VPC
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的类型。取值：
VBR：边界路由器实例。
VPC：专有网络实例
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the network instance
parameters.help_zh: 授权网络实例所在的地域ID
parameters.name: instance_region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Performs a dry run without modifying the service resource.
false (default): Sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique token from your client. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为 200 表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message that is used to replace the `%s` placeholder in the errorMessage parameter.

For example, if the value of errorMessage is The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and the value of DynamicMessage is DtsJobId, the specified DtsJobId parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.
